title: TruckLoadingOpt Input Schema
description: Input parameters for the Hershey's Truck Loading Optimization Remote Function.

project_id.title: project_id
project_id.description: AERA project UUID identifying the workspace context for data retrieval and output storage.

plan_id.title: plan_id
plan_id.description: Unique identifier for the planning run; namespaces input/output folders and log files.

apo_truck_load.title: apo_truck_load
apo_truck_load.description: API name of the APO Truck Load dataset in the AERA workspace; contains order-to-truck assignment candidates.

truck_capacity_details.title: truck_capacity_details
truck_capacity_details.description: API name of the Truck Capacity Details dataset; defines truck types, capacities and utilization constraints.

dc_slot_schedule.title: dc_slot_schedule
dc_slot_schedule.description: API name of the DC Slot Schedule dataset; defines available loading dock windows per distribution center.

general_configurations.title: general_configurations
general_configurations.description: API name of the General Configurations dataset; contains solver flags and model configuration parameters.

delimiter.title: delimiter
delimiter.description: Column delimiter character used when writing output CSV files to the AERA dataset.

truncate_flag.title: truncate_flag
truncate_flag.description: If 'true', truncates destination AERA datasets before writing output; prevents duplicate rows across runs.

sdk_workspace.title: sdk_workspace
sdk_workspace.description: Name of the AERA SDK workspace used for dataset uploads and downloads.

sdk_destination_path.title: sdk_destination_path
sdk_destination_path.description: AERA SDK destination folder where output datasets are written after optimization.
